title: Business Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Business Analyst role at Tort Experts

About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve. If you’re looking for a workplace where your contributions can truly make a difference, and where innovation meets purpose, Tort Experts is the perfect place for you.

About The Role

We are hiring a Business Analyst to strengthen our Client Services team by owning reporting, reconciliation, and proactive analysis across client accounts. This role ensures accuracy in case counts and budgets, surfaces performance insights, and creates scalable reporting solutions that empower the entire team.

The ideal candidate is mid-level, highly analytical, and able to take full ownership of results with minimal oversight. They are adept at spotting trends, building actionable reports, and anticipating issues before they become problems. Over time, this role may evolve into a companywide business analyst position, with broader responsibility for insights and reporting across teams.

Location: Remote (must be available 9am - 5p ET)

What You'll Do

Client Reporting & Reconciliation

  • Case Data Reconciliation: Own the process of reconciling signed case counts between internal systems and client reports, resolving discrepancies independently.
  • Fund Reallocations: Accurately process client requests to move budgets across projects, ensuring all updates are reflected in reporting.
  • Custom Reporting: Deliver accurate, client-ready reports that align with goals and expectations, while continuously improving report templates and workflows.

Proactive Analysis & Insights

  • Issue Detection: Monitor conversion rates, lead quality, and profitability by lead type and field values to proactively spot risks and opportunities.
  • Performance Analysis: Provide insights into client and campaign profitability, pricing effectiveness, and lead monetization trends.
  • Self-Serve Reporting: Build dashboards and recurring reports that give team members visibility into critical KPIs without requiring manual analysis each time.
  • Scalable Insights: Develop frameworks for analyzing trends that can be reused across clients and campaigns.

Operational Excellence & Financial Control

  • Accuracy Safeguarding: Ensure all reconciliations, reallocations, and reports are error-free and backed by clear data sources.
  • Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in reporting and reconciliation, and create scalable solutions that save time and reduce errors.
  • Collaboration: Support the Director of Client Services by taking on data-heavy work, freeing leadership to focus on strategy and client growth.

Client-Facing Support

  • Email Communication: Participate in client email threads to share reconciled numbers, reporting deliverables, and updates related to reallocations.
  • Light Client Interaction: Join occasional client calls to clarify data, while leaving strategic discussions to the Director of Client Services.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in business analysis, reporting, client operations, or related analytical roles. Experience in legal case acquisition or performance marketing is a plus.
  • Technical Skills: Master level of proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas) and reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to slice/dice data, reconcile discrepancies, and extract actionable insights across multiple variables (lead type, conversion rates, profitability, etc.).
  • Automation & Tools: Comfortable building repeatable reports, dashboards, and using AI or automation to accelerate data comparison and analysis.
  • Ownership: Able to take responsibility for results with little oversight, quickly becoming the go-to person for reporting and analysis.
  • Communication: Clear, concise written skills for client-facing updates and internal reports.
  • Adaptability: Ability to learn new systems quickly and thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift rapidly.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Extremely detail-oriented and accuracy-obsessed.
    • High ownership, proactive problem-solver who identifies issues before others see them.
    • Curious and driven to dig into data until key insights emerge.
    • Comfortable in a support role, enabling leadership to focus on higher-level strategy.
    • Growth-oriented, eager to expand from client-level reporting into companywide business analysis.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance
  • 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):
    • medical (Aetna)
    • dental (Guardian)
    • vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution
  • 401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
  • Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
  • Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation.

Job Title: Senior Google Media Buyer & Strategist

Location: Remote LATAM preferred (PST overlap required)

Salary Range: $2,600–$3,000/month

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm PST

NOTE: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR POSITION

Company Overview: Sagan is an exclusive membership community for top executives, founders, and CEOs seeking to hire and maximize the impact of international talent. We bridge the gap between global talent and US-based businesses, connecting candidates from vibrant regions like Latin America, the Philippines, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Africa with leading American companies. Sagan provides a high-performance remote work environment, ensuring access to world-class opportunities for top-tier professionals.

About the Company: Sagan represents a fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing team that manages large-scale ad campaigns and delivers measurable results for clients across diverse industries. The team values strategic thinking, proactive ownership, and high-performance execution.

Position Overview: We are seeking a Senior Google Media Buyer & Strategist to own the planning, execution, and optimization of Google Ads campaigns. This role combines hands-on media buying with strategic oversight, ensuring campaigns consistently deliver strong ROI. The ideal candidate will have experience managing large budgets and providing strategic guidance directly to clients.

  • Plan, launch, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, YouTube, and Performance Max.
  • Develop and execute strategies to achieve performance goals (ROAS, CPA, CPL, etc.).
  • Manage monthly budgets of $100K–$300K+ with accountability for performance outcomes.
  • Monitor, analyze, and report on campaign performance, providing actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to align strategies with business objectives.
  • Stay current on Google Ads trends, features, and best practices.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads campaign management experience.
  • Proven track record managing large monthly budgets ($100K+).
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, with advanced proficiency in Google Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and related tools.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (C1 or equivalent, 70+ on Sagan scale).
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and provide strategic recommendations.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, or Pinterest Ads.
  • Background in agency environments or multi-client portfolio management.
  • Familiarity with conversion tracking, tag management, and A/B testing.

description:
Overview

Runware is building a leading API for all AI. Our platform makes it easy for developers to add advanced media generation capabilities to their products in hours instead of months, without the burden of managing GPUs, scaling, or constant model updates. By combining custom hardware with optimized software and orchestration, we deliver unmatched speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across hundreds of thousands of models. Backed by top global investors, we're growing quickly and building a team to shape the future of AI development.

About The Role
We\'re looking for Developer Relations to be the technical voice connecting our media generation API with the developer community. You\'ll bridge the gap between our engineering team and the developers building on Runware—from indie creators to enterprise teams integrating our generation capabilities into their products.

First and foremost, you must be passionate about generative AI and able to demonstrate it through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, or other hands-on work. We\'re looking for builders with some development experience. You don\'t need to be a superstar engineer, but you should be comfortable writing and debugging code.

This is an intentionally broad role that will flex around your strengths. It could include creating educational content, debugging integrations, supporting developers, building SDKs and integrations, or representing Runware at events and hackathons. You might maintain SDKs or third-party integrations, build new integrations, or contribute workflow examples and tutorials. A key part of the role is bringing value to our ecosystem which could include being active in public — sharing your work, engaging with other developers, and making technical content visible across socials, forums, and communities. You\'ll help Runware have a strong presence where developers already are.

Nice to Haves

Empresa empregadora TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Domínio Geociências & Reservatório

Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI)

Experiência Mínimo 10 anos

Context & Environment

Posição baseada no Rio de Janeiro, nos escritórios da subsidiária, em regime residente.

A posição exige desenvolvimento de comunicação transversal com outras entidades da TotalEnergies, DIG, parceiros (em especial Petrobras) e matriz.

Trabalho em equipe multicultural de geociências.

Demonstrar multifuncionalidade e solidariedade na equipe de Geociências.

Atividades

O colaborador deverá realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado para salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, preservando o meio ambiente e os recursos, contribuindo para melhorar a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos da empresa e sua reputação.

Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes relevantes e regras da empresa. Realizar treinamentos adequados para melhorar seu comportamento em HSE.

Respeitar e fazer cumprir as regras de HSE, inclusive no que diz respeito à confidencialidade das informações.

Antecipar questões ambientais relacionadas ao negócio e implementar ações corretivas, reportar anomalias.

Atenção especial aos tópicos potenciais de HSE relacionados a reservatórios: pressões de injeção, integridade da cobertura, reinjeção de gás, descarte de água, etc.

Contribuições para a robustez técnica dos modelos geológicos e de reservatórios:

Dentro do ativo, auxiliar na realização de tarefas relacionadas à Geofísica e Geologia, garantindo que interpretações sísmicas, de poços e construções de modelos sejam conduzidas conforme as regras da especialidade de Geofísica de Reservatórios.

Contribuir para a robustez do modelo estático e sua adequada transferência para o modelo dinâmico.

Facilitar a integração entre Geociências e Engenharia de Reservatórios (2G&R) durante as fases de inicialização e ajuste histórico do modelo de reservatório e ao longo das fases iterativas entre disciplinas técnicas.

Contribuir para a robustez do desenvolvimento proposto, padrão de poços e perfis de produção.

Garantir que as incertezas estáticas e dinâmicas mais impactantes sejam identificadas, avaliadas e refletidas nos modelos de reservatórios.

Propor novas oportunidades para os ativos, cenários alternativos e soluções inovadoras.

Acompanhar e propor otimizações nas atividades de aquisição sísmica, processamento sísmico 3D e 4D.

Acompanhar estudos de inversão sísmica 3D e 4D.

Por meio de uma visão transversal 2G&R:

Garantir coerência entre as atividades conduzidas por todas as disciplinas 2G&R envolvidas.

Transmitir incertezas interdisciplinares utilizando análogos e experiências anteriores.

Contribuir para melhorar a robustez das avaliações, da metodologia utilizada, das estratégias de desenvolvimento e da aceitação pelos parceiros.

Auxiliar na consistência técnica das interfaces com outras entidades do projeto:

Interagir com atores transversais (especialistas da matriz, departamentos de outras afiliadas, parceiros, autoridades).

Alertar a gestão em caso de inconsistência técnica entre avaliação geocientífica e de reservatórios e sua inclusão no projeto de desenvolvimento, ou inconsistência com abordagens de parceiros / operador / autoridade.

Elaboração de relatórios e solicitação de validações, tanto externas (parceiros e órgãos reguladores) quanto internas (dentro da subsidiária e com entidades da matriz):

Desenvolvimento da equipe.

Contribuir para o treinamento de profissionais juniores por meio de coaching e compartilhamento de expertise.

Se solicitado pelo líder da equipe, pode auxiliar na definição de planos de treinamento dentro da equipe.

Promover integração entre disciplinas e com especialistas da matriz.

Capacidade desenvolvida para lidar simultaneamente com múltiplas tarefas, interagindo com diversos membros da equipe.

Abordagem de melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades:

Manter total conformidade com os procedimentos da TotalEnergies e alinhamento com seus interesses e visão de longo prazo.

Representar a afiliada perante parceiros externos e organizações de negócios, sempre em alinhamento e respeitando os valores e estratégias da TotalEnergies.

Contribuir com feedback técnico sobre metodologias e ferramentas.

Influenciar parceiros e operador em decisões importantes para a gestão do campo.

Perfil do Candidato

Formação: Bacharelado em Geofísica ou Geologia, Mestrado em Geofísica do Petróleo, Doutorado ou Engenheiro Geofísico.

Experiência profissional: mínimo de 8 anos.

Fluência em português e inglês é obrigatória.

Flexibilidade, proatividade, espírito de equipe e dedicação total ao trabalho são essenciais.

title: Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist role at Microsoft . We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home!

As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

Main qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with applicable law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Senior/Staff Founding Software Engineer (Cloud / Full Stack)

Full-Time

About the Role

As a Cloud / Full-Stack Engineer at iForAI, you'll build the backend systems and supporting frontend for our enterprise SaaS platform. You'll focus primarily on developing robust cloud infrastructure and backend services, while also implementing the straightforward web interfaces needed for our commercial offering.

Your core responsibility will be designing and building scalable cloud-native systems using TypeScript and modern infrastructure technologies. Additionally, you'll develop the React frontend components necessary for enterprise customers to configure, manage, and monitor their deployments. This combination of skills enables you to own features end-to-end.

This is a backend-first role that requires frontend capabilities. You'll work primarily with cloud services, API design, and infrastructure-as-code on the backend, while also leveraging React and TypeScript to implement the necessary frontend interfaces. Your work will ensure our enterprise platform delivers both the power and simplicity that customers expect.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, self-hostable cloud-native infrastructure using TypeScript
  • Build backend services, APIs, and data models that power our enterprise platform
  • Develop the straightforward frontend interfaces needed for our SaaS offering using React
  • Create deployment pipelines and infrastructure for both cloud-hosted and self-hosted options
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and observability for production systems
  • Optimize cloud performance, cost, and reliability across AWS
  • Ensure seamless integration between backend systems and frontend components
  • Maintain high code quality through testing, code reviews, and documentation
  • Own features end-to-end from backend implementation to frontend display
  • Contribute to our open source ecosystem where relevant to enterprise features

Our Requirements

  • 5+ years of TypeScript development experience
  • Strong backend and cloud infrastructure experience
  • Solid React frontend development skills
  • Experience with AWS services and cloud-native architecture patterns
  • Ability to build enterprise-grade systems with appropriate security and scalability
  • Comfort working across the stack from infrastructure to frontend
  • High level of autonomy, technical ownership, and self-direction
  • Fluent in English and strong communication skills

Nice-to-have

  • Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration experience
  • Infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation experience
  • Experience with multiple cloud providers (Azure, GCP)
  • Experience building developer tools and SDKs
  • LLM integration or AI infrastructure experience
  • Open source contribution history
  • Experience building and maintaining public APIs

Lead Machine Learning Engineer, Ad Performance

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We turn audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and relentless optimization.

Are you a Machine Learning Engineer with a passion for bridging technical expertise and business acumen? Do you thrive in building scalable, reliable systems that directly move revenue? If you’re eager to collaborate globally, face challenges head-on, and make substantial impact, we’re looking for you to join our dynamic team.

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of advertising algorithms, personalization, and optimization… building the ML software and infrastructure that drives ad performance and user engagement at scale.

MUST HAVE

You bring both the technical depth to design and deploy complex ML systems and the business intuition to know what actually moves KPIs. Specifically:

  • 7+ years of software development and ML engineering, including 3+ years focused on advertising systems
  • Proven experience optimizing ad performance using both mature models and emerging ML technologies
  • Expertise in one or more ML areas: Recommendation Systems, Advertising Algorithms, NLP, or CV
  • Proficiency with Python, SQL, and modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Familiarity with distributed data processing (Spark, Ray) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a proven track record of delivering measurable results
  • Excellent communication, teamwork, and project management skills

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Elevate Launch Potato’s advertising performance by building scalable, production-ready ML systems that optimize revenue while enhancing user experience. You’ll collaborate across teams to design, deploy, and refine algorithms that improve ad targeting, relevance, and efficiency at global scale.

OUTCOMES

  • Develop and scale advertising algorithms that optimize engagement and revenue simultaneously
  • Apply cutting-edge ML approaches (e.g., reinforcement learning, deep learning for ranking) to improve ad performance
  • Build scalable infrastructure to support real-time ad decisioning across millions of requests per day
  • Conduct rigorous experiments (A/B and multivariate tests) to measure model impact on business KPIs
  • Continuously improve ETL pipelines and monitoring systems to ensure reliable ad delivery
  • Collaborate with global teams across product, data, and engineering to launch high-impact ad features
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and integrate them into our ML stack when they create competitive advantage

COMPETENCIES

  • Impact-Oriented : You align ML systems to business outcomes and measure what matters
  • Technical Builder : You write clean, production-ready code and architect scalable systems
  • Collaborative : You work seamlessly with global teams and communicate complex ideas clearly
  • Resilient & Determined : You don’t shy from challenges and drive projects through to impact
  • Curious Innovator : You keep pace with ML/AI trends and creatively apply them to advertising
  • Analytical Problem-Solver : You break down complex systems and find data-driven solutions

title: TÉCNICO DE GESSO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Join to apply for the TÉCNICO DE GESSO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Organizar a sala de imobilização, checando os equipamentos e materiais necessários para realização de procedimentos de acordo com as solicitações médicas, acolhendo os pacientes de modo que sejam atendidos continuamente em suas necessidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Curso de Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica Completo;
  • Experiência de 06 meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica/Técnico de Gesso.

Informações adicionais

Local: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho X 36 horas de descanso

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home!

As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management.

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

title: Staff Software Engineer  (Fraud team)
description:
At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI-powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting-edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross-border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before.

We are a hyper-growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top-tier global investors. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long.

About The Role

Join Félix as a Staff Software Engineer on our dedicated Fraud team, where you'll play a pivotal role in building and enhancing our defenses against financial crime. This position demands a blend of deep technical expertise and a keen understanding of fraud typologies. You will be responsible for architecting and implementing advanced, data-driven systems that proactively identify and mitigate risks across our platform.

What You Bring

  • A passion for understanding fraud trends and mitigating risk while protecting the customer experience.
  • A builder’s mindset, ready to scale processes in a start-up environment.
  • Energy and enthusiasm to make an impact in a fast-paced, collaborative role.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Risk Platform Development: Drive the entire technology and platform development for the company's risk needs, ensuring a functionally rich, reliable, and high-performance.
  • Own Architecture & Strategy: Take full ownership of the Risk platform's technology and architecture, collaborating closely with Engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Innovate & Elevate Solutions: Continuously challenge the status quo, setting a high bar to deliver superior technical solutions that comprehensively address all risk requirements.
  • Strategic Partnership: Work closely with leaders in Risk Product and Risk & Compliance to gain deep business understanding and collaboratively develop effective technical solutions.
  • Ensure Operational Excellence: Guarantee reliable production execution of the Risk Platform with robust observability, providing clear visibility to all partners.
  • Leverage Data & AI: Partner with Data, AI, and other Risk leaders to effectively leverage the Data Platform and AI Platform for critical risk needs.
  • Seamless Integration: Collaborate with solutions architecture, product, and engineering teams to ensure the Risk Platform is seamlessly integrated, delivering reliable and high-performance execution across all products and systems.
  • Shape Technical Vision: In partnership with the Engineering teams, drive the technical vision and strategy for Risk, balancing immediate needs with long-term objectives.
  • Foster Technical Excellence & Culture: Set a high technical bar, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to engineering teams on principles, skills, and best practices.
  • Strengthen Security & Reliability: Partner with security and SRE organizations to continuously improve security, meet SLOs, and effectively manage error budgets.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in Fraud Prevention: Direct, hands-on experience in fraud prevention, detection, or mitigation within fintech, financial services, or a similar industry.
  • 10+ years in Software Development: A senior-level engineer with a proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying software at scale.
  • Risk Platform Architect: Extensive experience in the risk domain, including the architecture and development of Risk platforms.
  • System Design & Scale: Designing distributed systems, handling high-throughput real-time processing, and architecting for scale (millions of transactions/day).
  • Sharp Tech Skills: Exceptional ability to analyze large datasets to identify patterns and trends, and to resolve complex problems.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Solid understanding of PCI DSS and SOX compliance requirements.
  • Leadership Expectations: Inspire and guide our team by setting high technical standards, offering mentorship, and championing best practices.
  • Natural Investigator: A curious and incisive mind, capable of uncovering the core reasons behind fraudulent activities and crafting proactive, effective prevention strategies.
  • Effective Collaborator: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to partner seamlessly with cross-functional teams, articulate findings clearly, and influence strategic decisions.
  • Self-Driven & Accountable: A self-starter with excellent judgment, comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative in dynamic environments.
  • Flexible & Responsive: Adaptable to changing priorities and able to respond to critical fraud risks, which may occasionally require working outside standard business hours.
  • Current Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of fraud detection tools, machine learning models, and industry best practices.
  • Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level or higher is required.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Initial stock options grant
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Remote work environment
  • Continuous learning opportunities
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid parental leave
  • Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Na TAG, acreditamos que o conhecimento aplicável é capaz de revolucionar o mercado financeiro e torná-lo mais transparente, acessível e inclusivo. E é por isso que aqui oferecemos soluções tecnológicas para registrar o volume financeiro que o estabelecimento comercial tem a receber pela venda no cartão dos seus produtos e serviços, promovendo o acesso democrático ao crédito e ajudando a fomentar novos negócios por todo o país.

Aqui, você vai trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, que respira tecnologia no dia a dia e é referência no mercado por inovação e expertise. Tudo isso de forma 100% remota, em home office. Quer saber como funciona uma Registradora de Recebíveis? Acesse nosso site .

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Product Manager:

Buscamos um(a) Product Manager para garantir a qualidade e atuar na evolução estratégica da nossa plataforma de registro e escrituração de Duplicatas Escriturais. Sua missão será conduzir o produto em um ecossistema financeiro interoperável e dinâmico, assegurando total aderência às normas do Banco Central (especialmente a Resolução BCB nº 339/23) e às regras de negócio definidas na Convenção de Duplicatas Escriturais.

Você será uma peça-chave para conectar a estratégia de negócio às necessidades do mercado e à execução técnica. Seu desafio será navegar a complexidade regulatória, identificar oportunidades de alto impacto e guiar um time multidisciplinar na construção de soluções que resolvem problemas reais para nossos clientes, gerenciando a integração do ativo com outros instrumentos e obrigações financeiras do mercado.

  • Definição da Visão e Governança do Roadmap: Conduzir a criação, comunicação e governança do roadmap estratégico do produto, balanceando com maestria as demandas regulatórias mandatórias, as evoluções da Convenção, as necessidades dos clientes e a visão de longo prazo do negócio.
  • Liderança de Discovery e Estratégia de Mercado: Liderar o processo de discovery contínuo para identificar e validar novas oportunidades, analisando o cenário competitivo, o impacto sistêmico de novas regulações e as dores do cliente para fundamentar as decisões estratégicas do produto.
  • Tradução Estratégica para a Execução: Traduzir os objetivos de negócio e as complexas exigências regulatórias em épicos e diretrizes claras para o time de Product Owners, garantindo que as histórias de usuário e os critérios de aceite estejam sempre alinhados com a visão macro.
  • Gestão de Stakeholders e Risco Sistêmico: Gerenciar as expectativas e o alinhamento com stakeholders de alto nível (Diretoria, Jurídico, Risco, Compliance), antecipando e mitigando riscos inerentes às soluções propostas, considerando implicações financeiras, de negócio e de experiência do cliente em múltiplos domínios.
  • Definição de Métricas e OKRs: Estabelecer os Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) e Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) do produto, definindo o que é sucesso e garantindo que o time esteja focado em métricas de impacto que movem os ponteiros do negócio.
  • Condução da Interoperabilidade: Orientar a estratégia de integração e evolução da nossa plataforma frente às demais IURs (Infraestruturas do Mercado Financeiro) signatárias da Convenção, assegurando nossa posição e competitividade no ecossistema.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência consolidada na liderança estratégica de produtos, definindo a visão e o roadmap de plataformas transacionais complexas.
  • Forte afinidade e vivência em tecnologia, com capacidade para navegar em discussões técnicas e arquiteturais.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes de negócio regulados pelo Banco Central do Brasil, com habilidade para traduzir normas em estratégia de produto.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida de produtos, do discovery ao lançamento e iteração contínua, com foco na jornada do cliente.
  • Comunicação assertiva e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplos stakeholders, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados, com foco na definição e acompanhamento de métricas de negócio para medir o impacto das entregas.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Vivência direta com os desafios e a dinâmica da Convenção de Duplicatas Escriturais e os requisitos da Resolução BCB 339/23.
  • Experiência prática no ecossistema de recebíveis, seja em registradoras (IURs), fintechs de crédito, FIDCs ou no setor bancário.
  • Conhecimento profundo sobre a interoperabilidade entre diferentes Infraestruturas do Mercado Financeiro (IMFs).

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerTager

Aqui na TAG, valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar nesse movimento de transformação do mercado financeiro. Se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
We're urgently hiring a Senior Staff Engineer to join our growing LATAM-based remote team.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we're transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we're investing in the next generation of our platform—and we're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help drive it.

Why This Role Rocks

  • Own What You Build - Lead projects end-to-end with full autonomy and real impact
  • Remote & Flexible - Work from anywhere and set your own hours
  • Build Meaningful Tech - Help shape the tools that thousands of homeowners and service pros rely on daily
  • Join at the Right Time - We have strong product-market fit and real momentum—you'll help define what comes next

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: PHP (Laravel), JavaScript (React, React Native, Vue)
  • Cloud Services: AWS (Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora, Redshift)
  • Approach: We're not fixated on specific languages. If you have strong engineering fundamentals and experience with any mainstream object-oriented language, we believe you can quickly learn and adapt to our tech stack

What You'll Do

As a Senior Staff Engineer , you'll work closely with the Software Architect and other engineers to:

  • Collaborate on designing and implementing system architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards.
  • Lead technical initiatives across teams, ensuring alignment with architectural direction and goals.
  • Build and maintain platform-level components, services, and libraries that enhance engineering efficiency and system maintainability.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on guidance.
  • Contribute directly to both server-side and client-side development across the entire stack.
  • Write and review technical design documents, system diagrams, and reference implementations.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and best practices to continuously improve our platform.
  • Enhance observability, performance, scalability, and security throughout our system.
  • Share knowledge and insights to foster team growth and improvement.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced: A principal engineer, lead full-stack engineer, or someone with relevant experience in similar roles.
  • Highly skilled in both server-side and client-side software development.
  • Technically Proficient: Familiar with cloud development (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure).
  • Experienced with Test Driven Development (TDD), RESTful APIs, React, MVC frameworks, and security concerns (e.g., XSS attacks).
  • Fundamentally Strong in Computer Science Concepts: You can explain concepts like Big O notation, pointers, composition vs. inheritance, and data structures such as arrays, sets, and linked lists.
  • Database-Savvy: Proficient in SQL and NoSQL databases, and understand operations like CRUD, indexes, and joins.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Expert: Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora) and utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IAC).
  • Customer-Centric: Passionate about clean code and building customer-driven solutions with a focus on quality and reliability

Benefits

  • Perks of Working with Us
    • Competitive contract rate
    • Work from anywhere
    • Flexible hours—get the work done on your schedule
    • High ownership and autonomy
    • Fast-moving team that loves to build, learn, and grow

description:
Psicólogos (as) Wellz | Inscrição 10/2025

Join to apply for the Psicólogos (as) Wellz | Inscrição 10/2025 role at Wellz by Wellhub

Sobre o Wellz

Em 2021, o Wellhub fundou o Wellz com o objetivo de democratizar a saúde mental no Brasil. Possibilitamos que empresas ajudem suas equipes a serem mais saudáveis, mais resilientes e mais profundamente engajadas. Através da nossa plataforma, é possível realizar atendimento clínico individual online, acessar conteúdos interativos sobre saúde mental e participar de rodas de conversa em grupo.

Facilitamos o acesso das pessoas a uma jornada de autocuidado e autoconhecimento que seja ideal para as suas necessidades individuais. A abordagem que utilizamos é a Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental, com intervenções voltadas para a melhora clínica individual e baseadas em evidências.

A oportunidade

O Wellz está crescendo e, por isso, estamos procurando psicólogos e psicólogas com experiência clínica para fazer parte da nossa comunidade. Você receberá pacientes, realizará sessões de psicoterapia, terá acesso a supervisão gratuita e fará parte de uma inovadora solução de cuidado à saúde mental.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia;
  • Especialização ou pós graduação completa em Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental;
  • Experiência prévia realizando psicoterapia on-line individual;
  • Inscrição ativa no Conselho Regional de Psicologia (CRP);
  • Habilidades para conduzir atendimentos de forma online;
  • Possuir computador para realização de atendimento clínico, assim como outros equipamentos que garantam a qualidade do atendimento;
  • Ter empresa aberta, cuja atividade seja compatível com serviços psicológicos.

Por que fazer parte do time de parceiros do Wellz?

  • Nova fonte de renda, sem custo extra para se juntar à nossa rede;
  • Acesso a novos pacientes, trazidos diretamente até você;
  • Flexibilidade de horário, com a possibilidade de criar a sua própria agenda;
  • Metodologia comprovada, baseada em dados e tecnologia;
  • Comunidade de terapeutas para dividir aprendizados e melhores práticas;
  • Supervisão clínica sem custo e com orientação direcionada;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para cuidar da sua saúde de forma integral.

O Wellz é para todas as pessoas, independente da religião, orientação sexual, etnia, gênero e outros. Se você preenche os requisitos necessários, se inscreva e venha fazer parte dessa rede que só cresce!

  • Essa oportunidade é referente a uma parceria de prestação de serviços e, dessa forma, não configura vínculo empregatício.

title: Supervisor a de seguranca do trabalho
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição Da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Segurança do Trabalho para atuar na gestão direta da equipe de técnicos de segurança, estruturando rotinas, garantindo os recursos necessários e promovendo alinhamento entre as demandas corporativas e operacionais, com foco no atendimento aos clientes internos (Gasodutos, Projetos, Manutenção, Integridade, entre outros).

Essa pessoa será responsável por oferecer suporte técnico à equipe, acompanhar a execução das atividades e monitorar as entregas, assegurando o cumprimento contínuo das diretrizes de saúde e segurança estabelecidas pela empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a equipe de técnicos de segurança, estruturando rotinas e garantindo os recursos necessários;
  • Alinhar demandas corporativas e operacionais, com foco no atendimento aos clientes internos (Gasodutos, Projetos, Manutenção, Integridade, etc.);
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, tratar não conformidades e elaborar documentos do sistema de gestão;
  • Orientar tecnicamente os técnicos de segurança nos processos de gestão integrada.
  • Propor diretrizes de gerenciamento de riscos e apoiar na elaboração de ferramentas como AR, LPR e PT.
  • Acompanhar atividades críticas em campo, contribuindo com o planejamento de segurança;
  • Apoiar ações para atendimento à legislação vigente e mapear mudanças regulatórias;
  • Identificar não conformidades por meio de inspeções e auditorias em campo;
  • Ministrar treinamentos e promover o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe;
  • Participar de análises de causa de incidentes e garantir a execução dos planos de ação;
  • Monitorar atividades da equipe e realizar inspeções em frentes de serviço e contratadas;
  • Estruturar a programação dos técnicos, priorizando atividades críticas;
  • Apoiar na coleta e análise de dados para indicadores de performance em saúde e segurança;
  • Conduzir a gestão da equipe com feedbacks individuais, workshops de alinhamento e reuniões periódicas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão, auditorias, análise de riscos e gestão de equipes;
  • Conhecimento em legislação de saúde e segurança, ferramentas de análise de causa e indicadores de performance.

Como Se Preparar Para o Processo Seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade
  • Previdência privada
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile)
  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day-off de aniversário
  • TotalPass
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)

Aqui, você será parte de uma empresa sólida, com propósito claro e que valoriza o bem-estar, o respeito.

Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

title: Head of Growth Marketing
description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re looking for a Highly Motivated & Hard-Working Head of Growth Marketing to join the team.

As a Head of Growth Marketing, you will be at the heart of crafting data-driven forecasts and executing strategies that push our clients toward their goals. Your actions and initiatives consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role extends past strategy alone, it’s also about fostering strong client relationships by clearly communicating the steps taken and how results compare to projections. This ongoing transparency builds trust and strengthens the connection between CTC and its clients, helping them navigate the nuances of media buying and long-term growth planning.

You stand as a representative and dedicated advocate for CTC's distinctive approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools. As a Head of Growth Marketing, you are held to a high standard. People know that if you are involved, things will get accomplished.

You thrive on challenges, are committed to delivering measurable results, and take great pride in giving it your all. We embrace the mantra, 'Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,' meaning that you can see things through to the end!

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

KICK OFF PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the kick off.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of the kick off, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Head of Growth Marketing, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to the next level.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. As a Product Data Specialist, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. At LawnStarter, we're transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we're investing in the next generation of our platform—and we're looking for a Product Data Specialist to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your Primary Responsibility Will Be To Empower Our Organization To Be More Data-driven, And There Are Many Ways To Accomplish That, Such As

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with various moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an extremely exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analysis and models we need have different degrees of complexity, from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. We expect you to have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R
  • Reporting: If a complex system creates an exciting pool of opportunities, it also creates a high number of metrics that we need to keep track of to run the business efficiently. However, a dashboard is only as good as our trust in being correct and updated. It's your responsibility to understand the needs of the teams you'll be working with and help the Analytics team create and maintain our reporting system, keeping it organized and user-friendly. For that, you'll be mainly using Tableau and Metabase
  • Analytics Engineering: Although it won't be your main focus, occasionally, you will need to work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets to empower our reports and end users within the organization. Understanding the business needs and consolidating them into our DW is crucial to maintaining a reliable single source of truth. We use DBT for the data transformation, so SQL experience is a must

Requirements

  • Experience: You have 4+ years of experience in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: You have a STEM or business background or relevant education that makes you suited to empower our organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions. You can absorb a variety of topics with extreme ease, having a structured and logical approach to developing your understanding of the business and its challenges. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique
  • Team player: You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on each
  • Bias for action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems and identifying opportunities, you actively try to avoid being a perfectionist or getting yourself tied up in knots. You have a bias for action in order to make progress. You enjoy being scrappy and constraints enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go

description:
A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS. Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. SOBRE A POSIÇÃO:

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Gestão de base de dados: Consolidar informações de todas as áreas da diretoria financeira (FP&A, capital, despesas, reportes); Criar e manter estruturas de banco de dados relacionais (SQL, SQLite, MySQL, ou similares); Garantir qualidade, integridade e segurança das informações.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

Será um diferencial se você também tiver:
